title: 2x2 AND-OR-INVERT (7450 - 7451 - 7460)

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 5 (pin assignments and function tables)
TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 6 (gate and flip-flop data sheets)

pins.name: X
pins.text: expander node of gate 1: connect to the X output of a 7460 expander; leave open if not used

pins.name: X'
pins.text: expander node of gate 1: connect to the X-bar output of a 7460 expander; leave open if not used

functions.formula: 1Y = NOT ((1A AND 1B) OR (1C AND 1D) OR X)
functions.text: Gate 1 (expandable): 1Y is low when 1A and 1B are both high, or 1C and 1D are both high, or an expander on X/X' has all its inputs high. X = output of a 7460 expander.
Gate 2: 2Y is low when 2A and 2B are both high, or 2C and 2D are both high.

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, expander pins open
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, expander pins open
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, from an input of a 7460 expander
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, from an input of a 7460 expander

electrical.notes: Designed for use with up to four 7460 expanders. Expander current IX' max -3.1 mA (SN7450, VCC MIN, TA MIN).

notes: The manual title groups 7450, 7451 and 7460; this file describes the 7450 (one gate expandable, one not). The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
